title: EDG C++ front-end goes public
title_zh: EDG C++前端模型 goes public

paragraphs.en: Read John Spicer's note on what's next for EDG, and the transition FAQ →
paragraphs.zh: 阅读 John Spicer 关于 EDG 后续计划及过渡常见问题的说明 →

paragraphs.en: On September 30, 2026, the source for EDG's C++ front end went public, and The C++ Alliance became its nonprofit home. Same engine, same standards, professionally maintained, and open to contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月30日，EDG的C++前端源代码公开，C++联盟成为其非营利性归属机构。 同样的引擎，同样的标准，专业维护，并欢迎贡献。

sents.en: On September 30, 2026, the source for EDG's C++ front end went public, and The C++ Alliance became its nonprofit home.
sents.zh: 2026年9月30日，EDG的C++前端源代码公开，C++联盟成为其非营利性归属机构。

sents.en: Same engine, same standards, professionally maintained, and open to contributions.
sents.zh: 同样的引擎，同样的标准，专业维护，并欢迎贡献。

paragraphs.en: Continuity is the point. This is a change of steward, not a change of course.
paragraphs.zh: 连续性才是关键。 这只是管理者的更替，而不是方向的改变。

sents.en: Continuity is the point.
sents.zh: 连续性才是关键。

sents.en: This is a change of steward, not a change of course.
sents.zh: 这只是管理者的更替，而不是方向的改变。

paragraphs.en: For thirty years, EDG's front end has powered C++ compilation across the industry as the only production-quality source-to-source engine of its kind.
paragraphs.zh: 三十年来，EDG 的前端一直是业界唯一一款生产级质量的源到源引擎，为整个行业的 C++ 编译提供支持。

paragraphs.en: This section will cover EDG's founding, the people behind it, the milestones of its front end, and the compilers and tools built on top of it. Have a piece of that history to share? Open an issue on the site's repository.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将介绍 EDG 的创立历程、其背后的人物、其前端的重要里程碑，以及基于它构建的编译器和工具。 有一段相关历史想要分享吗？ 请在本网站的仓库中打开一个 issue。

sents.en: This section will cover EDG's founding, the people behind it, the milestones of its front end, and the compilers and tools built on top of it.
sents.zh: 本节将介绍 EDG 的创立历程、其背后的人物、其前端的重要里程碑，以及基于它构建的编译器和工具。

sents.en: Have a piece of that history to share?
sents.zh: 有一段相关历史想要分享吗？

sents.en: Open an issue on the site's repository.
sents.zh: 请在本网站的仓库中打开一个 issue。

paragraphs.en: When the source went public on September 30, 2026, professional maintenance had to continue. EDG needed a new home that could do three things at once.
paragraphs.zh: 当该源代码于2026年9月30日公开时，专业维护仍须继续。 EDG需要一个能够同时做到三件事的新家。

sents.en: When the source went public on September 30, 2026, professional maintenance had to continue.
sents.zh: 当该源代码于2026年9月30日公开时，专业维护仍须继续。

sents.en: EDG needed a new home that could do three things at once.
sents.zh: EDG需要一个能够同时做到三件事的新家。

paragraphs.en: Receive and manage donations on behalf of EDG.
paragraphs.zh: 代表 EDG 接收和管理捐款。

paragraphs.en: Sustain the engineering quality EDG users depend on.
paragraphs.zh: 维持 EDG 用户所依赖的工程质量。

paragraphs.en: C++ compiler front-end knowledge, from the inside.
paragraphs.zh: 从内部深入理解 C++ 编译器前端知识。

paragraphs.en: The C++ Alliance is a nonprofit with proven fiscal-sponsorship infrastructure, C++ compiler engineers on staff, and deep roots in the C++ standards and Boost communities. It now serves as EDG's nonprofit home.
paragraphs.zh: C++ 联盟是一个非营利组织，拥有成熟的财务托管基础设施、在职的 C++ 编译器工程师，并与 C++ 标准社区和 Boost 社区有着深厚的渊源。 它现在作为 EDG 的非营利归属机构。

sents.en: The C++ Alliance is a nonprofit with proven fiscal-sponsorship infrastructure, C++ compiler engineers on staff, and deep roots in the C++ standards and Boost communities.
sents.zh: C++ 联盟是一个非营利组织，拥有成熟的财务托管基础设施、在职的 C++ 编译器工程师，并与 C++ 标准社区和 Boost 社区有着深厚的渊源。

sents.en: It now serves as EDG's nonprofit home.
sents.zh: 它现在作为 EDG 的非营利归属机构。

paragraphs.en: EDG now works like any other open source project: anyone can contribute, and everything that lands is available to everyone. Development follows three tracks: contributions from the user community, ongoing maintenance, and collectively funded features.
paragraphs.zh: EDG 现在像其他任何开源项目一样运作：任何人都可以参与贡献，且所有合并的内容都对所有人开放。 开发遵循三条路线：来自用户社区的贡献、持续的维护，以及由集体资助的功能。

sents.en: EDG now works like any other open source project: anyone can contribute, and everything that lands is available to everyone.
sents.zh: EDG 现在像其他任何开源项目一样运作：任何人都可以参与贡献，且所有合并的内容都对所有人开放。

sents.en: Development follows three tracks: contributions from the user community, ongoing maintenance, and collectively funded features.
sents.zh: 开发遵循三条路线：来自用户社区的贡献、持续的维护，以及由集体资助的功能。

paragraphs.en: Bug fixes and new features from EDG users, submitted as pull requests. Reviewers, who are initially experienced EDG developers, evaluate the changes. Once approved, these changes are merged into the EDG codebase.
paragraphs.zh: 来自EDG用户的错误修复和新功能，以拉取请求的形式提交。 审阅者（最初是经验丰富的EDG开发者）会对这些变更进行评估。 一旦获得批准，这些变更就会被合并到EDG代码库中。

sents.en: Bug fixes and new features from EDG users, submitted as pull requests.
sents.zh: 来自EDG用户的错误修复和新功能，以拉取请求的形式提交。

sents.en: Reviewers, who are initially experienced EDG developers, evaluate the changes.
sents.zh: 审阅者（最初是经验丰富的EDG开发者）会对这些变更进行评估。

sents.en: Once approved, these changes are merged into the EDG codebase.
sents.zh: 一旦获得批准，这些变更就会被合并到EDG代码库中。

paragraphs.en: Bug fixes and maintenance by the Alliance's EDG developers are published immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 由联盟的 EDG 开发者进行的错误修复和维护会立即发布。

paragraphs.en: To support the EDG community, the Alliance will provide a way for larger features to be developed and funded by the community. In this way, organizations can support the development of larger features financially rather than committing their developers to the development of these features. Once a feature is funded, it is released to everyone at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持 EDG 社区，联盟将提供一种方式，让更大的功能特性由社区来开发和出资。 这样，组织可以通过出资来支持较大功能特性的开发，而不必把自己的开发人员投入到这些功能的开发中。 一旦某个功能特性获得资助，它将在同一时间向所有人发布。

sents.en: To support the EDG community, the Alliance will provide a way for larger features to be developed and funded by the community.
sents.zh: 为了支持 EDG 社区，联盟将提供一种方式，让更大的功能特性由社区来开发和出资。

sents.en: In this way, organizations can support the development of larger features financially rather than committing their developers to the development of these features.
sents.zh: 这样，组织可以通过出资来支持较大功能特性的开发，而不必把自己的开发人员投入到这些功能的开发中。

sents.en: Once a feature is funded, it is released to everyone at the same time.
sents.zh: 一旦某个功能特性获得资助，它将在同一时间向所有人发布。

paragraphs.en: One codebase, for everyone. Whichever track a change arrives on, it lands in the same public repository at the same time. No one gets early access.
paragraphs.zh: 一套代码库，面向所有人。 无论改动通过哪条渠道提交，它都会在同一时间进入同一个公开仓库。 任何人都没有提前访问权。

sents.en: One codebase, for everyone.
sents.zh: 一套代码库，面向所有人。

sents.en: Whichever track a change arrives on, it lands in the same public repository at the same time.
sents.zh: 无论改动通过哪条渠道提交，它都会在同一时间进入同一个公开仓库。

sents.en: No one gets early access.
sents.zh: 任何人都没有提前访问权。

paragraphs.en: The Fiscal Sponsorship Committee (FSC) oversees the process across all three tracks. It is chaired by John Spicer and will include volunteers from the EDG user community.
paragraphs.zh: 财务赞助委员会（FSC）监督全部三个轨道的流程。 该委员会由约翰·斯派瑟担任主席，并将包括来自 EDG 用户社区的志愿者。

sents.en: The Fiscal Sponsorship Committee (FSC) oversees the process across all three tracks.
sents.zh: 财务赞助委员会（FSC）监督全部三个轨道的流程。

sents.en: It is chaired by John Spicer and will include volunteers from the EDG user community.
sents.zh: 该委员会由约翰·斯派瑟担任主席，并将包括来自 EDG 用户社区的志愿者。

paragraphs.en: Want a say in who sits on it? See how to get involved .
paragraphs.zh: 想对谁担任该职位有发言权吗？ 了解如何参与。

paragraphs.en: The engine, the standards it implements, and the person you talk to stay the same. How the work is funded and where the code lives do not.
paragraphs.zh: 引擎、它所实现的标准，以及你与之对话的智能体都保持不变。 但工作的资金来源和代码的存放位置却会改变。

sents.en: How the work is funded and where the code lives do not.
